# UW Departments Web Server

> > Shared web hosting service for University of Washington departments, featuring research labs, student organizations, and academic resources including gesture recognition technology and chemical engineering graduate programs.

This server hosts diverse UW department websites, prominently featuring the ACE Lab's gesture recognition research (including the $1 Recognizer and statistical tools) and ACES chemical engineering graduate student organization. It serves as a central platform for academic research dissemination, student engagement, and departmental web presence.

## Key Topics

- University of Washington
- Gesture recognition
- Chemical engineering
- $1 Recognizer
- ACES graduate students
- HCI research
- R statistical analysis
- STEM outreach
- Jacob O. Wobbrock
- Shared web hosting
- Graduate student symposium
- Accessibility research
- Template matching
- Professional development
- Community engagement

## Gesture Recognition Research

- [$1 Recognizer](https://depts.washington.edu/acelab/proj/dollar/index.html): $1 Unistroke Recognizer: 2D gesture recognition template-matching tech
- [Impact of $-family](https://depts.washington.edu/acelab/proj/dollar/impact.html): Research impact and citations for $1, $N, $P, $P+, $Q gesture recognizers

## Research Tools and Resources

- [#Rstats](http://depts.washington.edu/acelab/proj/Rstats/index.html): R statistical inference code recipes by Jacob O. Wobbrock for HCI research
- [ACE Lab: Videos](https://depts.washington.edu/acelab/videos.html): Research videos on accessibility, touchscreen interaction, and HCI studies

## Chemical Engineering Graduate Students (ACES)

- [About ACES Outreach](https://depts.washington.edu/acesche/about): UW Chemical Engineering grad students' K-12 STEM outreach program
- [Calendar of Events](https://depts.washington.edu/acesche/events2/events): ACES ChemE grad student social and professional development events calendar
- [ACES Events Calendar](http://depts.washington.edu/acesche/calendar/aces-events-calendar): ACES graduate student organization event calendar at UW

## Getting Started

- [UW Departments Web Server](https://depts.washington.edu): Homepage for University of Washington's shared web hosting service

## Optional

- [2022 Graduate Student Symposium](https://depts.washington.edu/acesche/2022-graduate-student-symposium): 2022 ACES graduate student symposium hybrid event with research posters
- [2021 Graduate Student Symposium](https://depts.washington.edu/acesche/2021-graduate-student-symposium): 2021 UW ChemE graduate symposium with industry panel and presentations
- [2016 Outreach Events](https://depts.washington.edu/acesche/archives/1618): Archive of 2016 ACES K-12 STEM outreach events and science demos
